description: This file defines the MessageCommand class used for AJAX messaging in Drupal, including methods for rendering the command and attaching necessary assets.

classes.name: MessageCommand
classes.description: A class implementing AJAX command for displaying messages via Drupal's AJAX framework, supporting message content, display options, and asset attachment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for MessageCommand, initializes message content, display options, and whether to clear previous messages.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares the AJAX command payload with message details, handling markup and security filtering.

methods.name: getAttachedAssets
methods.description: Returns the assets (libraries) required for this AJAX command, specifically the 'core/drupal.message' library.
